summary: Golden Heaven Group Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $50 million of Class A ordinary shares. Craft Capital Management LLC acts as sales agent with 5.0% aggregate compensation. No escrow or minimum offering amount is set. The company is a Cayman Islands holdco with operations in China; its shares trade on Nasdaq under GDHG. This is an ordinary shelf takedown and capital raise, not a special situation. There is no premium, deal structure, or strategic component to watch; the filing is routine follow-on equity distribution.
